graph.title: Build a Robot (HTML & CSS)
notes: Step 1 was correct, so no parts were added or dropped. This tutorial is a software-only HTML/CSS project: it positions images on a web page in the Raspberry Pi online editor.
It uses no physical parts (no board, breadboard, wires, LEDs or other components), so the graph has no nodes and no edges.
The images (face, eyes1-3, mouth1) are web page elements, not physical parts, and the CSS positioning (top/left) is not a physical connection.
